No Dell mutation occurred -- every Dell command this phase was read-only. No src/pcae/**, docs/contracts/**, or scripts/** file was touched -- confirmed via git diff --name-only HEAD at phase close. Boundary P remains NOT AUTHORIZED (amended proposition ready for a fresh human election); Boundary C/A remain NOT AUTHORIZED; Class-B remains NOT PROVISIONED; HATP remains NOT READY; runtime unchanged.
